_comment: I0 provider playbook (schema: app/domain/playbook.py). Public facts only, every claim sourced. Kraken freezes on lawful law-enforcement requests where the funds are identified and held with it; victims report (scam report form) and are told to go to the police, IC3 / FTC and have officers submit Kraken's Compliance & Legal inquiry form. Kraken has no recovery or fund-release team.
notes: Kraken cannot reverse, recall or cancel a completed transaction, recover funds sent to a scammer or retrieve funds from another platform. It investigates activity on its own accounts and answers lawful requests from law enforcement, including freeze requests. The legal-inquiry form is open to anyone with a compliance or legal matter, but a freeze needs the officer's request.

channels.label: Compliance & Legal Inquiry form
channels.notes: For Compliance, Legal and Privacy / Data Protection inquiries (other topics may get no response). Kraken Support tells victims to have law enforcement submit 'the Compliance and Legal request' here; submitting opens a ticket and Kraken contacts the officer.

channels.label: Report a scam form
channels.notes: Kraken asks victims to report when a Kraken account was involved or Kraken was impersonated. The form may ask the reporter to sign in.

kraken.le.notes: Kraken Support points law enforcement to the Compliance & Legal Inquiry form (kraken.legal_form); its own help pages do not name an LE channel.

instrument.notes: Report to the local police and the national reporting body (US: IC3 and FTC) as well.

paths.notes: Kraken asks the victim to save: tx IDs and hashes, wallet addresses, dates, amounts, screenshots, e-mails and messages, the scammer's names, phones and websites. It does not recover funds: the reply points to the police. The form is meant for Kraken account holders and scams impersonating Kraken; for funds traced to a scammer's Kraken deposit address it is a notice at most: Kraken acts on lawful requests from law enforcement, including requests to freeze funds.

instrument.notes: A police / IC3 reference strengthens the notice; it is not an instrument.

paths.notes: A compliance notice that funds traced to a Kraken deposit address are stolen: it flags them and gets a ticket the officer can cite. No source says a private notice gets a freeze.

instrument.notes: A lawful law-enforcement request; Kraken freezes 'where those funds are identified and held with us'.

paths.notes: No SLA is published. Kraken checks legal sufficiency and scope and may narrow or challenge a request. The channel (the Compliance & Legal Inquiry form) is Kraken Support's pointer on X (k3, reported): the officer confirms it with Kraken.

instrument.notes: Subpoena or summons (the most common), court order or warrant.

paths.notes: 2025 transparency report: requests from 74 countries, data provided for about half. Non-US agencies may need an MLAT or letters rogatory (secondary).

instrument.notes: E.g. a UK crypto-wallet freezing order under POCA, obtained by the police.

paths.notes: Reported 2025 UK case: the police froze a Kraken wallet by a magistrates' court order and repatriation to the victim was ordered. Other jurisdictions' orders are not documented.
